name: The Tall Man

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Lair XP is 33,000 (the block lists 25,000 outside it).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.summary: 4 times a day (5 in its lair), a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When it fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead, 4 times a day or 5 times in its lair.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Memory's Dance
traits.summary: As a Bonus Action, any creature can dance a step from his old court and make a DC 20 Cha (Performance) check: on a success he takes 20 Force and has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the start of that creature's next turn.
traits.text: A creature other than the Tall Man can use a Bonus Action to perform steps from the dance of his lost court and make a DC 20 Charisma (Performance) check. On a success he takes 20 Force damage and has Disadvantage on his D20 Tests until the start of that creature's next turn.

traits.name: Regional Lair Effects
traits.summary: While it lives and keeps its lair, the land round it carries two effects: Deepening Shadows; Too Quiet.
traits.text: Deepening Shadows: within 1 mile of the lair, a creature can find a shadowy enough spot to hide in even without cover half the time. Too Quiet: within 1 mile of the lair, sounds are muffled and carry half as far. Both end at once if the Tall Man dies or moves his lair.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Claw attacks, and Spellcasting to cast Vicious Mockery (4d6 Psychic).

actions.name: Claw
actions.summary: +12, reach 15 ft, 2d6+6 Slashing plus 4d6 Psychic; a Large or smaller target is Grappled and Restrained (escape DC 14, two claws).
actions.text: A long-fingered rake: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing plus 14 (4d6) Psychic damage. A Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14) by one of his two claws and Restrained until it escapes.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: Casts Invisibility, Minor Illusion, Vicious Mockery (4d6 Psychic) at will, or Darkness twice a day (Cha, DC 19).
actions.text: He casts one of these spells with no Material components, using Charisma (spell save DC 19). At will: Invisibility, Minor Illusion, Vicious Mockery (4d6 Psychic). 2/day: Darkness.

bonus_actions.name: Elusive Disguise
bonus_actions.summary: Takes the shape of a Small or Medium humanoid, or back to his true form; always unnaturally tall for the guise.
bonus_actions.text: He changes into a Small or Medium humanoid he designs, or back to his true shape. Only his size changes; he is always oddly tall for the disguise. Worn gear changes with him, and he reverts if he dies.

reactions.name: Evasive Blink
reactions.summary: Takes Resistance to the damage that triggered it and teleports up to 30 ft to a space he can see.

options.name: Strike
options.summary: One Claw attack. Once a round.

options.name: Teleport
options.summary: Teleports up to 60 ft; a creature he is grappling must pass a DC 18 Cha save or goes with him.
options.text: He teleports up to 60 feet to a space he can see. A creature he is grappling makes a DC 18 Charisma save or teleports with him, appearing in the nearest free space to where he lands.

summary: A towering archfey who plays hide-and-seek in the dark: long reaching claws that hold, mocking words that burn, and a blink or teleport whenever he is hurt or cornered.
